operations.label: Prepare PbO, oleic acid and1-octadecene in2L three-neck reactor
operations.description: For non-example conditions, the common large-scale method is inherited with OA/initialODE adjusted at constant total volume. Exact individual volumes remain unknown; no graph coordinates inferred. Mainp2 uses50cm double-wall reflux condenser; TableS1 lists >50cm overall condenser height, internal cooling coil, elliptic50mm×20mm stirrer and2L three-neck flask. Dimensions are source annotations, not a scale drawing. Mainp2 requires supported reactor and source-limited thermal-difference precautions; no new apparatus specification supplied.
